name.ja: SDW HEROES 隠密ガンダムエアリアル

ja: 「ガンダム・エアリアル」×往年の名キャラクター「隠密頑駄無」×復活の輝羅鋼
待望の新旧要素を詰め込んだ新世代忍者、参上！
■輝羅鋼とは、射出成形とフィルムの貼り付けを同時に行うインモールド成形技術の応用。
■武装の組み替えで手裏剣を再現可能。
■可動に特化した内部フレームを内蔵。
■肘の可動範囲により二刀流の構えが決まる。
■別売りの「SDW HEROES 天下無双大将軍」との連動パーツが付属。
en: "Gundam Aerial " x Famous Character of the Past " Kikkushi Gundam" x Revival of Kira Steel
The long-awaited new generation ninja packed with new and old elements has arrived!
• Kirakko is an application of in-mold molding technology that performs injection molding and film attachment at the same time.
• Comes with a full range of equipment.
• Shuriken can be recreated by rearranging the weapons.
• Built-in internal frame specialized for movement.
• The range of motion of the elbows determines the stance of the dual wielder.
• Includes interlocking parts with "SDW HEROES Tenka Musou Taishogun" (sold separately).
